title: Stationary input head
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols and state set $S$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Suppose every transition of $M$, for every state and every scanned input and work-tape symbol, prescribes zero movement of the input head. Then for every configuration $d$ on $x$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the input-head position after running $M$ from $d$ for $t$ steps equals its initial position in $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Every transition has zero input-head movement
